gen-silkscreen-gf-sansation: Lo-fi and retro, Silkscreen leaves space around every letter. Silkscreen is best at blunt lines with no modulation at all, whereas Sansation, a sans with low modulation, is best at smooth, approachable curves without ink pooling.
gen-silkscreen-gf-sn-pro: Spaced-out letters, each ringed by room you can almost feel, give Silkscreen its lo-fi, spaghetti-line look beside SN Pro. The plain sans keeps curves open while the heading stays uniformly thick.
gen-silkscreen-gf-source-sans-3: Lo-fi spaghetti lettering: Silkscreen draws its diagonals just as stout as its stems. Source Sans 3, a plain sans whose a opens its lower bowl to breathe, gives the pair its edge: modern ease against stiff display.
gen-silkscreen-gf-spinnaker: Retro and lo-fi, with room around every letter. Silkscreen has no hairlines at all, so every stem matches, while Spinnaker, a plain sans, keeps its counters connected to the outside space.
gen-silkscreen-gf-varela: Retro spaghetti lines in Silkscreen meet Varela, a plain sans with a wide-mouthed c and a t whose crossbar matches its stem. One sets a lo-fi mood up top, the other keeps things friendly.
gen-silkscreen-gf-varta: Lo-fi, retro, and spaced out like spaghetti. Silkscreen is best at blunt, uniform lines, diagonals matching the uprights, while Varta, a plain sans, is best at big open eyes on every e and a.
gen-silkscreen-gf-wix-madefor-text: Retro to its core, Silkscreen spaces every letter generously. Wix Madefor Text, a sans with easy-to-read open terminals, brings the pair its strongest quality: a contemporary, steady counterpoint to constant-width lettering.
gen-silkscreen-gf-ysabeau-infant: Lo-fi spaghetti lettering: Silkscreen builds its uppercase from lines of constant thickness, with space around every single letter. Ysabeau Infant is the friendly one, terminals pointing outward like tongs.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zalando-sans: Zalando Sans, a plain sans with an open-ended look on every curve, sits under a lo-fi retro heading. Silkscreen excels at horizontal bars matching its upright stems, while Zalando Sans excels at soft curves.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded brings open-mouthed curves to a lo-fi, retro heading cut like sign-shop vinyl. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded supplies the pair's strongest quality: modern, fluid sans curves against rigid lines.
